runtimeDirectionReview.anglePrecision: Hand-drawn views assigned to sixteen logical sectors; projected angles are visually reviewed, not geometrically measured at exact 22.5-degree increments.

aerodynamicTuck.blend: speed threshold with smooth return to mounted pose

accelerationResponse.transition: fade back to mounted or tuck pose

gearShift.trigger: successful manual or automatic gear change

hardTurnLean.blend: crossfade from mounted or aerodynamic pose with smoothed bike lean
hardTurnLean.direction: positive lean selects left; negative lean selects right

impactBrace.trigger: blocked bike movement after moving faster than 0.35 metres per second
impactBrace.transition: crossfade back to mounted, turn, or tuck pose

runtimeMotion.steeringLean: continuous from steering input and speed

transitionModel.keyframes: base pose, authored midpoint, action pose
transitionModel.return: play the same keyframes in reverse through smoothstep weights
